youtube_title: Neural Drift Grand Prix (ML Race): Models Speedrun a Changing Universe
youtube_description:
Welcome to the Neural Drift Grand Prix—an epic visualization of machine learning competition. Watch Gradient Razor, Transformer Nova, Curriculum Comet, and more battle across an infinite hyperplane track where the data terrain shifts mid-race.

In this episode we visualize: 
• live loss convergence
• adaptation under distribution drift
• robustness vs speed tradeoffs
• ensemble and graph advantages

Which model do you think will win the final lap? Comment your pick!
